LanguageData.CG_Alpha_Desc: How much of what stands under a tree (pawns, weapons, items, corpses) shows through its canopy, the same under any number of trees. 0% makes canopies solid; 100% turns the see-through layer off completely (trees stay below pawns, no cost).
LanguageData.CG_Resolution_Desc: Resolution of the see-through layer, relative to the screen. Lower is lighter on the graphics card; canopies over things that show through get slightly softer. The layer is only drawn while something stands under a tree in view, and costs most in a battle in a dense forest.
LanguageData.CG_HideBetterTreesButton_Desc: Removes Better Trees' cursor-transparency button from the bottom-right controls. Its hotkey still works.
